initiatives.name: Social Bond Issuance Programme
initiatives.summary: Standard Chartered issued its first social bond worth €1 billion in 2025, diversifying its sustainable finance revenue mix and demonstrating commitment to social impact alongside environmental initiatives. This represents a significant milestone in the bank's sustainable finance journey.

evidence.title: Social bond issuance for SME lending
evidence.summary: Standard Chartered issued its inaugural €1 billion eight-year social bond in March 2025. The bond will primarily facilitate lending to SMEs, ensuring access to finance, helping create jobs and empowering women-owned SMEs.
evidence.quote: In March 2025, we issued our inaugural social bond. This €1 billion eight-year non-call seven-year offering will primarily facilitate lending to SMEs, ensuring access to finance, helping create jobs and empowering and nurturing women-owned SMEs.

evidence.title: Inaugural Social Bond Issuance
evidence.summary: Standard Chartered issued its first social bond worth €1 billion in 2025, diversifying its sustainable finance revenue mix and demonstrating commitment to social impact alongside environmental initiatives. This represents a significant milestone in the bank's sustainable finance journey.
evidence.quote: €1bn inaugural social bond issued. Alongside these milestones, we have now mobilised $157 billion in sustainable finance for our clients since January 2021 against our $300 billion target by 2030 and in 2025 issued Standard Chartered PLC's first social bond.

initiatives.name: Sustainable Finance Income Target Achievement
initiatives.summary: Standard Chartered exceeded its target of $1 billion annual sustainable finance income by 2025, generating $1.07 billion in 2025. This represents over 8.6% of total CIB income and a 9% year-on-year growth rate, demonstrating the success of their sustainable finance franchise.

evidence.title: Sustainable Finance Income Target Achievement

evidence.quote: The franchise generated over $1.07 billion between January and December 2025, exceeding our target of at least $1 billion annual income by 2025. $1.07bn^ sustainable finance income generated in 2025, exceeding our target of at least $1 billion annual income by 2025.

initiatives.name: Solv India Divestment to Jumbotail
initiatives.summary: SC Ventures completed the sale of Solv India to Jumbotail, creating one of India's largest B2B e-commerce platforms. The transaction resulted in SC Ventures reporting a gain of $0.2 billion in Q2 2025 results, demonstrating successful venture monetization.

evidence.title: Solv India Sale to Jumbotail

evidence.quote: SC Ventures completed the sale of Solv India to Jumbotail, one of India's leading B2B marketplaces. The combined business is now one of the largest B2B e-commerce platforms in India. As a result of the transaction, SC Ventures reported a gain of $0.2 billion in its second quarter 2025 results.

initiatives.name: Net Zero Scope 1 and 2 Emissions Achievement
initiatives.summary: Standard Chartered achieved net zero in Scope 1 and 2 emissions by the end of 2025, reducing carbon footprint by 96% from a 2018 baseline of 148 ktCO2e to just 6 ktCO2e. This milestone was achieved through energy efficiency improvements, renewable energy adoption, and green building certifications.

evidence.title: Net Zero Achievement in Operations

This milestone was achieved through energy efficiency improvements, renewable energy adoption, and green building certifications.
evidence.quote: We aim to reach net zero in our financed emissions by 2050, having reached net zero in our own operations (Scope 1 and 2 emissions) in 2025. In 2025, we achieved our net zero target across Scope 1 and 2 emissions, marking a significant milestone. We reduced our carbon footprint by 96 per cent from a 2018 baseline of 148 ktCO2e to just 6 ktCO2e.

initiatives.name: Priority Private Wealth Centre Expansion

In 2025, the bank also opened additional Wealth Centres in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan and Korea, bringing the total number to 16.

initiatives.name: Chair Leadership Transition
initiatives.summary: Maria Ramos succeeded José Viñals as Chair of Standard Chartered, bringing both continuity and fresh perspective. The transition marks an important leadership change as the bank enters its next chapter of growth.

evidence.title: New Chair Appointment - Maria Ramos

evidence.quote: This year marks an important transition in our leadership, as Maria Ramos succeeded José Viñals as Chair. We are grateful to José for his steady guidance and commitment, which have been instrumental in steering the bank through a dynamic period. Maria's appointment brings both continuity and fresh perspective; she is exceptionally well placed to guide us through the next chapter.

initiatives.name: Circular Economy Innovation Hub Launch
initiatives.summary: Standard Chartered established its fifth Innovation Hub focused on the circular economy to identify, facilitate and scale bankable opportunities that minimize economic impact on planetary support systems. The Hub published 'Scaling Circular Finance: No Time to Waste' paper outlining critical levers for stakeholders.

The programme incurred charges of $531 million in 2025 compared to $156 million in 2024, with 2026 being the final year of charges.

initiatives.name: Group CFO Leadership Transition
initiatives.summary: Pete Burrill was appointed as interim Group Chief Financial Officer, bringing extensive sectoral experience and providing continuity to the finance function leadership following Diego's departure. Pete's appointment ensures stability during the transition period.

evidence.title: CFO leadership transition
evidence.summary: On 10 February 2026, Diego De Giorgi stepped down from his role as Executive Director and Group Chief Financial Officer. Pete Burrill was appointed as Interim Group Chief Financial Officer with effect from 10 February 2026.
evidence.quote: On 10 February 2026, we announced that Diego De Giorgi stepped down from his role as Executive Director and Group Chief Financial Officer, and that Pete Burrill was appointed as Interim Group Chief Financial Officer with effect from 10 February 2026.

evidence.title: Interim Group CFO Appointment
evidence.summary: Pete Burrill was appointed as interim Group Chief Financial Officer, bringing extensive sectoral experience and providing continuity to the finance function leadership following Diego's departure. Pete's appointment ensures stability during the transition period.
evidence.quote: As Pete, our interim Group Chief Financial Officer, will explain in more detail, we made good progress in both respects in 2025. I would like to take this opportunity to thank Diego for his valuable contribution during his tenure. Pete brings extensive sectoral experience and provides valuable continuity to the leadership of our finance function.

initiatives.name: Share Buyback Programme
initiatives.summary: Standard Chartered announced a new $1.5 billion share buyback programme to commence imminently, following completion of previous buyback programmes totaling $2.8 billion. Total shareholder distributions announced since full-year 2023 results reach $9.1 billion, demonstrating strong capital returns to shareholders.

evidence.title: Share Buyback Programme
evidence.summary: Standard Chartered announced a new $1.5 billion share buyback programme to commence imminently, following completion of previous buyback programmes totaling $2.8 billion. Total shareholder distributions announced since full-year 2023 results reach $9.1 billion, demonstrating strong capital returns to shareholders.
evidence.quote: The Group completed a $1.5 billion share buyback programme during the first half of the year and the $1.3 billion share buyback programme announced on 31 July 2025 was completed on 26 January 2026. The increased dividend, along with a new share buyback programme of $1.5 billion to be commenced imminently, takes the total shareholder distributions announced since the full-year 2023 results to $9.1 billion.
